evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/disputes/pages/CreateDisputePage.tsx:29-42 — handleSubmit is a fake-success stub: `await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)); navigate('/disputes');`. It NEVER sends the collected `formData` (CreateDisputeRequest: respondentId, title, description, category, desiredResolution) to any API. The user fills the full 'File New Dispute' form, clicks Submit, sees a 1s spinner then a redirect that looks like success — but nothing is ever persisted. Every field the user typed is silently discarded.

This is a duplicate/orphan of the REAL create flow. The routed page for /disputes/new is FileDisputePageRoute (routes/groups/disputes.tsx:482 `<Route path="/disputes/new" element={<FileDisputePageRoute />} />`), which wraps FileDisputePage and wires the genuine `useCreateDispute` mutation (FileDisputePageRoute.tsx:32,42 `createDispute.mutateAsync(...)`). CreateDisputePage is exported from the barrel (features/disputes/pages/index.ts:6) but is NOT routed or referenced by any component/test — a latent trap: any dev who wires this exported 'CreateDisputePage' up gets a form that drops disputes on the floor.

Fix: delete the dead CreateDisputePage.tsx and remove its barrel export, OR wire handleSubmit to the existing useCreateDispute mutation (mutateAsync + try/catch surfacing the error) instead of the setTimeout stub. Verify no import references remain (grep found only the self-export).

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/disputes/pages/DisputeDetailPage.tsx — a LIVE routed page (lazyRoutes.tsx:82, rendered from routes/groups/disputes.tsx:384 for /disputes/:id) that imports useTranslation (L7,149) but only calls t() for a handful of aria labels (e.g. t('aria.closeDialog') L483,525) — grep counts just 4 t() usages across 597 lines. None localize on the ppt-web UI.
Fix: move these literals into the i18n resource bundle (t('disputes.detail.*')) as already scaffolded for the aria labels; the useTranslation hook is already in scope so this is a low-risk sweep.
